Required change: Make the SPARQL constraint select only cases that establish applicability, so the branch conforms when the category/date combination is outside category A or B on or after the threshold, while preserving xsd:date validation for every present constructionDate value. | [LOGIC] MainShape/sh:or first branch/loadingConditionCase/sh:node/sh:or: The residual-stability-factor alternative is allowed regardless of alternativeInstrumentApplicable. A loading condition with alternativeInstrumentApplicable=true and residualStabilityFactorSI=1 can therefore pass without alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus=true, although the declared formula requires the permitted alternative-instrument outcome when the alternative applies. Required change: Guard the residualStabilityFactorSI=1 branch with alternativeInstrumentApplicable=false, leaving the alternative branch as alternativeInstrumentApplicable=true together with alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus=true.
